name: skillswap-campus
description: SkillSwap Campus — student web app + admin panel (UI only, shared design layer)

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix user-web && npm run build --prefix admin-web
scripts.check: npm run check --prefix user-web && npm run check --prefix admin-web
